pattern: 損なう / 損ねる / 損じる（そこなう / そこねる / そんじる）
aliases: そこなう / そこねる / そんじる
purpose: Fail to complete an action or perform it incorrectly.
keywords: Vます stem + 損なう / 損ねる / 損じる
I missed hearing the important number.
I failed to catch the final ball.
formation: Vます stem + 損なう / 損ねる / 損じる
restrictions: Can mean missing an opportunity or making an error, depending on the verb.
mistake: The object and verb determine whether the action was missed or mishandled.
